title: Drop an app module's core dependency by narrowing the client field type
answers: How do we remove apps/<name>'s dependency on github.com/grafana/grafana?
apps/quotas go.mod still requires grafana core, how was that broken?
Why doesn't pkg/registry/apps/quotas/register.go need to change when core dependency is removed?
body:
Symptom: an apps/* module requires github.com/grafana/grafana in go.mod just to hold a field typed as core's resource.ResourceClient, creating a replace-directive cycle and preventing the module from being consumed outside this repo.
Root cause: the app only ever calls methods that are already declared on a standalone generated pb interface (e.g. resourcepb.QuotasClient) that the app already depends on directly; the concrete core type is used only because it's a superset.
Fix pattern: change the field/interface type to the narrower pb-generated interface the app already imports (resourcepb.QuotasClient). Core's concrete resource.ResourceClient still implements it structurally, so callers in pkg/registry/apps/<name>/register.go that construct and pass the core client need no change.
Constraints: applies only when every core method actually used is already exposed on a standalone module interface (commonly pkg/storage/unified/resourcepb). Does not apply if business logic, not just a client call, lives in core.
applies: apps/* modules that embed a core unifiedStorage/resource.ResourceClient-typed field and want to drop the grafana core dependency (remaining candidates per PR description: advisor, dashvalidator, iam, plugins)

search: Replace a concrete core resource.ResourceClient field type with the narrower pb-generated interface (e.g., resourcepb.QuotasClient) it already depends on, eliminating the apps/* module's unnecessary dependency on github.com/grafana/grafana. The app only calls methods already exposed on the pb interface; core's client implements it structurally so existing register.go callers need no code changes. Apply only when every core method used exists on a standalone module interface like resourcepb; does not apply if business logic (not just client calls) lives in core. Candidate modules: advisor, dashvalidator, iam, plugins. See apps/quotas/go.mod and pkg/registry/apps/quotas/register.go.
